citations.desc: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
citations.narrative:
Two dedicated surgical rooms used for the trap neuter release (TNR) program for cats have porous ceiling tiles. At the
time of inspection there was one cat undergoing a surgical procedure.
Porous ceiling tiles may be difficult to clean and sanitize as required. Dirt and other debris may collect within the porous
surfaces and contaminate the surgical fields. All survival surgery should be performed using aseptic procedures… major
operative procedures on non-rodents should be conducted only in facilities intended for that purpose which shall be
operated and maintained under aseptic conditions.
To be corrected by September 15, 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representatives.
